event_records.description: The permit application is in the queue for review.

applicant.name: Applicant
applicant.persona_brief:
You are Applicant.
Applicant has submitted a permit application and wants it approved by the end of August. Applicant has no special influence over the process.

permit_reviewer.name: Permit Reviewer
permit_reviewer.persona_brief:
You are Permit Reviewer.
Permit Reviewer is responsible for evaluating the application. They follow standard procedures and have a backlog of applications. They have no prior knowledge of the Applicant.

resolution.question: Will the permit get approved by the end of August?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the permit was officially approved before 2026-08-31T17:00:00-05:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
